points.identity_evidence: MacKenzies River open shoreline mouth east of McKenzie Point. Main broad river traced from southern bends and valley; modern named terminal line 269093 ends at coast. Historical mouth/bank detail differs.
points.rejection_reason: Proposed native point lies on land beside a broad historic inlet. The inlet has no uniquely established shoreline/centreline endpoint equivalent to modern terminal feature 269093; road crossing and generalized banks cannot substitute for a matched mouth point.
